listing.summary: Upstream route: Windows 0.5 ZIP contains runtime/setup: ImportISO validates own disc and prepares assets/shaders, then PlayDarkwatch.exe starts directly. Windows 0.5 runtime/setup; latest 0.5.5 is a Linux Proton compatibility test with no new Windows asset. Do not select globally newest tag for every platform. Upstream platforms: Windows 10 v1903+/11 x64 D3D12. Linux/Steam Deck use Proton Experimental; 0.5.5 is a compatibility test, not native Linux. Original data: Original Xbox Darkwatch supported North American revision; full/trimmed ISO; exact default.xbe validation.
